stories.description: ASUS has issued an urgent security update for ASUS Control Center Enterprise (ACC) after researchers uncovered a maximum-severity vulnerability that lets remote attackers seize complete administrative control over the platform and every device it manages,…

stories.title: Hackers Exploiting MikroTik RouterOS Vulnerability in the Wild to Gain Complete Network Access
stories.description: Attackers are actively exploiting an unauthenticated remote access flaw in MikroTik RouterOS, and network administrators worldwide are being urged to patch their devices immediately before compromise turns into a full network takeover.

stories.title: Attackers Hijack MikroTik Routers Through Internet-Exposed SSH Without Authentication
stories.description: Attackers gain full administrative control of MikroTik routers through internet-exposed SSH without authentication, CERT Polska says.

stories.title: Four REVSTEALER-Linked Modules Disable Windows Update and Defender to Run a Crypto Miner
stories.description: Four persistent programs linked to REVSTEALER can steal wallet data, proxy attacker traffic, and mine cryptocurrency.

stories.title: 10 Best ZTNA Solutions (Zero Trust Network Access) In 2026
stories.description: Best ZTNA Solutions: 1. Zscaler 2. Cisco 3. Perimeter 81 4. Fortinet 5. Cloudflare 6. Akamai 7. Palo Alto Networks 8. Forcepoint.

stories.title: Hackers Actively Exploiting Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-Day RCE Vulnerability
stories.description: A newly discovered zero-day vulnerability in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce is being actively exploited by attackers to seize full control of online stores, and there is still no official patch available.

stories.title: Unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce Zero-Day Exploited to Backdoor Online Stores
stories.description: Sansec says attackers exploit an unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce flaw to run server code without authentication and install persistent backdoors.

stories.title: Attackers Breached JetBrains Cadence via Unpatched TeamCity, Extracting AWS Credentials
stories.description: Attackers exploited CVE-2026-63077 to breach JetBrains Cadence, accessing a 2024 backup containing credentials and user data.

stories.title: Elementor Pro WordPress Plugin Vulnerability Exploited to Hack Sites
stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-32475 (CVSS score of 9.8), the bug described as an arbitrary file upload issue in the function that handles form submissions.

stories.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
stories.description: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
